name: Shephatiah
overview: Shephatiah is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as the son of Mattan. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide further details about his tribe or other distinguishing notes. His mention is brief and specific to his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Shephatiah means 'y-h-v-h has judged,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's judgment. This proper name is noted in Jeremiah 38:1, highlighting its biblical origin without indication that it was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Shephatiah is explicitly identified as the son of Mattan, according to Jeremiah 38:1. Scripture does not record any additional family relationships for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Shephatiah's significance in the biblical narrative is primarily tied to his identification as Mattan's son. This connection places him within the context of Jeremiah 38:1, contributing to the historical and genealogical framework of the passage. Though details about his personal role are limited, his mention supports the broader narrative of the period.
